prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: country learning postcard for Botswana
Primary request: The Okavango Delta with winding clear wetland channels and a small, plausible African elephant family.
Subject: A broad inland wetland landscape, crystal-clear teal water flowing in sinuous channels between reed and papyrus beds, grassy islands and scattered low woodland. Two adult African elephants and one calf wade calmly near a grassy bank, with credible anatomy, large ears, trunks and proportions.
Scene/backdrop: Flat seasonal floodplain stretching to a low distant horizon under a blue sky, with green marsh plants and hints of dry ochre grass beyond the wetland. This is an inland delta, with no sea, mountains or city.
Style/medium: Cheerful detailed children's-book travel illustration, painterly gouache and digital watercolour with visible brush texture, believable wetland geography and wildlife, gentle saturated teal, ochre, green and coral.
Composition/framing: One landscape 3:2 image, intended 1536x1024. Slightly elevated scenic view showing the winding channels clearly; the elephant family and main channel comfortably inside central 75% width and height, with generous breathing room.
Lighting/mood: Warm natural daylight, peaceful and welcoming.
Constraints: Stylized educational illustration. No text or letters, UI, flags, logos, watermark, postcard frame or stamp. No giant buildings, waterfalls, ocean beach, invented mountains, unrelated landmarks or fantasy animal anatomy.
inspection: Inspected: winding clear teal wetland channels among reeds, papyrus, grassy islands and scattered trees, with a flat seasonal floodplain horizon. Two adult African elephants and one calf wade together with plausible ears, trunks and proportions; the group is comfortably framed. No sea, mountains, buildings, readable text, flags, UI or logos.
